title: vosu.play
description: Best-effort, declared common namespace (ADR 0020): the current play's universal values. Fields are `null`, never a zero/empty placeholder, when the plugin's manifest does not declare them. Capability id: field:vosu.play(.<path>).

score.description: Current score, in the game's own scale (not normalized across games).

maxCombo.description: Highest combo reached so far this attempt.

accuracy.description: Current accuracy, 0-1, under the formula named by `accuracyKind`.

accuracyKind.description: Identifies the game's own accuracy formula; core never normalizes accuracy across games. A game with more than one formula (e.g. per client variant) uses a distinct id for each.

health.description: Current health/HP, 0-1. `null` for games/rulesets without a health resource.

progress.description: Fraction of the chart elapsed, by play time over chart length. `null` outside an active chart (e.g. menus) or when length is unknown.

rate.description: Effective playback rate (tempo multiplier) applied by mods or client settings; `1.0` at normal speed.

judgements.description: Game-declared judgement breakdown for the current attempt, best to miss by `ordinal`. `null` when the plugin does not fill this field; an empty array means the game declared no judgement kinds, which core treats like `null` for display.
